name: girovest-server
description: Girovest API server — Express + Prisma, SQLite or Postgres.
author: Girovest

scripts.db:migrate: npm run db:schema && prisma migrate dev
scripts.build:electron-bundle: esbuild dist/server.js --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --outfile=dist-bundle/server-bundle.mjs --external:bcrypt --external:better-sqlite3 --external:pg-native --banner:js="import { createRequire } from 'module'; const require = createRequire(import.meta.url);" && esbuild dist/migrate-cli.js --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --outfile=dist-bundle/migrate.mjs --external:better-sqlite3 --banner:js="import { createRequire } from 'module'; const require = createRequire(import.meta.url);"
scripts.test:setup: dotenv -e .env.test -- npm run db:schema && dotenv -e .env.test -- prisma db push
scripts.test:postgres: npm run test:postgres:up && dotenv -e .env.test.postgresql -- npm run db:generate && dotenv -e .env.test.postgresql -- prisma db push && dotenv -e .env.test.postgresql -- vitest run; npm run test:postgres:down; npm run db:generate
